---
title: "Steam Reviews Extractor"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---
```{r}
# Install the packages only once is enough :D
install.packages("httr")
install.packages("jsonlite")
install.packages("lubridate")
install.packages("cld3")
```

```{r}
# Load packages before running any code :D
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(cld3)
```


```{r}
get_steam_reviews_sample <- function(app_id,
                                     start_date = "2026-01-01",
                                     end_date = "2026-04-01",
                                     target_n = 90,
                                     max_pages = 10000) {
  
  base_url <- paste0("https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/", app_id)
  
  cursor <- "*"
  page <- 0
  empty_count <- 0
  
  all_reviews <- list()
  
  start_date <- as.Date(start_date)
  end_date <- as.Date(end_date)
  
  repeat {
    
    page <- page + 1
    
    res <- GET(
      base_url,
      query = list(
        json = 1,
        filter = "recent", # rank reviews from most recent
        language = "english", # filter for English reviews only
        review_type = "all", # includes both purchase and free games
        purchase_type = "all",
        num_per_page = 100,
        cursor = cursor
      ),
      user_agent("Mozilla/5.0")
    )
    
    raw <- content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
    
    # skip broken responses
    if (nchar(raw) == 0 || grepl("<html", raw)) {
      cat("Skipping bad response (HTML or empty)\n")
      next
    }
    
    data <- tryCatch(
      fromJSON(raw),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("JSON parse error, skipping page\n")
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
    
    if (is.null(data)) next
    
    # stop if no reviews
    if (is.null(data$reviews) || length(data$reviews) == 0) {
      empty_count <- empty_count + 1
      if (empty_count >= 2) break
      next
    } else {
      empty_count <- 0
    }
    
    reviews <- data$reviews
    
    # SAFE extraction (fixes nested list issue)
    df <- data.frame(
      review_text = reviews$review,
      playtime_hours = round(reviews$author$playtime_at_review / 60, 1),
      timestamp = reviews$timestamp_created,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # date conversion
    df$date <- as.Date(as.POSIXct(df$timestamp, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"))
    
    # ALWAYS store the page first
    all_reviews[[length(all_reviews) + 1]] <- df
    
    # THEN check stopping condition
    oldest_date_in_page <- min(df$date, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (oldest_date_in_page < start_date) {
      cat("Reached reviews older than start_date. Stopping.\n")
      break
    }
    
    cat("Page:", page, 
        "| Reviews:", nrow(df), "\n")
    
    # pagination control
    cursor <- data$cursor
    
    if (page >= max_pages) break
    if (is.null(cursor) || cursor == "") break
    
    Sys.sleep(1)
  }
  
  # combine safely
  final_df <- bind_rows(all_reviews)
  
  cat("\nTOTAL RAW REVIEWS:", nrow(final_df), "\n")
  
  # count all reviews in date range (no word count filter)
  n_in_timerange <- final_df %>%
    filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date) %>%
    nrow()
  
  cat("ENGLISH REVIEWS IN DATE RANGE (NO WORD FILTER):", n_in_timerange, "\n")
  
  # filter for word count
final_df <- final_df %>%
  filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date) %>%
  mutate(word_count = sapply(review_text, function(x) {
    length(strsplit(trimws(x), "\\s+")[[1]])
  })) %>%
  filter(word_count >= 20 & word_count <= 300) |> 
  # Language detection to ensure reviews are English
  mutate(detected_lang = cld3::detect_language(review_text)) %>%
  filter(detected_lang == "en")

cat("IN DATE RANGE + WORD COUNT FILTER:", nrow(final_df), "\n")
  
  # sampling logic
  if (nrow(final_df) == 0) {
    warning("No reviews in date range")
    return(final_df)
  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  
  if (nrow(final_df) <= target_n) {
    return(final_df)
  } else {
    return(sample_n(final_df, target_n))
  }
}

# THIS IS WHERE YOU NEED TO ENTER THE STEAM ID FOR THE GAME!!!
reviews_sample <- get_steam_reviews_sample(
  app_id = 646570 # ENTER/CHANGE THE STEAM ID HERE :D
)
```


```{r}
# RUN THIS CHUNK TO VIEW CLEANED REVIEWS
reviews = reviews_sample |> 
  select(-timestamp) |> 
  select(-word_count) |>
  select(-detected_lang) |> 
  relocate(2,3,1)
View(reviews)
```
